Result: --!strict
-- TutorialService: server owner of first-60-seconds tutorial state.
-- Creates the 'TutorialStep' RemoteEvent at require time; other services call notify().

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local TutorialConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("TutorialConfig"))
local ForgeTelemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))

local EVENTS = TutorialConfig.EVENTS

-- One place that creates the remote.
local remote: RemoteEvent
do
	local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(TutorialConfig.REMOTE_NAME)
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		remote = existing
	else
		remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		remote.Name = TutorialConfig.REMOTE_NAME
		remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
end

type State = {
	fired: { [string]: boolean },
	done: boolean,
	startedAt: number,
}

local states: { [Player]: State } = {}

-- Ordered events the server drives; each fires at most once and only in order.
local ORDER = { EVENTS.CLAIMED, EVENTS.CASHED, EVENTS.BOUGHT }

local TutorialService = {}

local function numberFrom(inst: Instance?): number
	if inst and (inst:IsA("IntValue") or inst:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return (inst :: IntValue).Value
	end
	return 0
end

-- Rebirths are stored in the 'Rebirths' leaderstat; owned upgrades are tracked
-- on the player as the 'UpgradesOwned' attribute (0 if nothing is recorded yet).
local function hasRebirthed(player: Player): boolean
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if stats and numberFrom(stats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")) > 0 then
		return true
	end
	local attr = player:GetAttribute("Rebirths")
	return type(attr) == "number" and attr > 0
end

local function ownedUpgrades(player: Player): number
	local attr = player:GetAttribute("UpgradesOwned")
	if type(attr) == "number" then
		return attr
	end
	return 0
end

local function isActive(player: Player, state: State?): boolean
	if not state or state.done then
		return false
	end
	if os.clock() - state.startedAt > TutorialConfig.TOTAL_SECONDS then
		state.done = true
		return false
	end
	return player.Parent == Players
end

function TutorialService.notify(player: Player, eventName: string)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or not isActive(player, state) then
		return
	end
	local nextEvent: string? = nil
	for _, name in ORDER do
		if not state.fired[name] then
			nextEvent = name
			break
		end
	end
	if nextEvent == nil or eventName ~= nextEvent then
		return
	end
	state.fired[eventName] = true
	if eventName == EVENTS.BOUGHT then
		-- last server-driven step; client handles the SHOP step locally
		state.fired[EVENTS.BOUGHT] = true
	end
	ForgeTelemetry.count("tutorial_steps", 1)
	remote:FireClient(player, eventName)
end

local function setup(player: Player)
	if states[player] then
		return
	end
	local state: State = { fired = {}, done = false, startedAt = os.clock() }
	states[player] = state

	task.spawn(function()
		-- leaderstats may not exist yet; wait briefly, then give the client time to load.
		player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 5)
		task.wait(1.5)
		if states[player] ~= state or player.Parent ~= Players then
			return
		end
		if hasRebirthed(player) or ownedUpgrades(player) >= TutorialConfig.SKIP_UPGRADES then
			state.done = true
			remote:FireClient(player, EVENTS.SKIP)
			return
		end
		remote:FireClient(player, EVENTS.START)
		-- The plot is auto-claimed shortly after joining, so the "walk to a CLAIM gate"
		-- step would contradict the game. Advance to step 2 right away
		-- ("Watch your dropper make cash"). notify() counts tutorial_steps and is
		-- ignored if a manual claim already advanced the step.
		TutorialService.notify(player, EVENTS.CLAIMED)
	end)

	task.delay(TutorialConfig.TOTAL_SECONDS + 2, function()
		if states[player] == state then
			state.done = true
		end
	end)
end

local started = false

function TutorialService.start()
	if started then
		return
	end
	started = true
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		states[player] = nil
	end)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		setup(player)
	end
end

return TutorialService

-- PlotClaimService: themed plot claiming, auto-claim after timeout, release on leave.
--
-- Plot-table shape (normalized once in init, used everywhere afterwards):
--   index        number
--   theme        theme table
--   origin       CFrame   (plot center / spawn point)
--   spawnCFrame  CFrame   (where claimed players are teleported)
--   gate         Instance? (claim gate model/part)
--   plot         table    (the table handed to Tycoon.new)
--   Owner        Player?  (nil while free)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local PlotThemes = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlotThemes"))
local Telemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))
local PlazaBuilder = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("PlazaBuilder"))
local Tycoon = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Tycoon"))

local PlotClaimService = {}

local entries = {} -- list of plot entries
local claimedBy = {} -- [Player] = entry
local tycoons = {} -- [entry] = tycoon
local gateState = {} -- [entry] = { {inst, prop, value}, ... }
local busy = {} -- [Player] = true while claiming
local initialized = false

-- RebirthService is required lazily (it may depend on this module) to avoid
-- a circular require at load time.
local rebirthService = nil
local rebirthTried = false

local function getRebirthService()
	if rebirthService or rebirthTried then
		return rebirthService
	end
	local module = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("RebirthService")
	if not module then
		return nil -- not available yet; try again next time
	end
	rebirthTried = true
	local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
	if ok then
		rebirthService = result
	else
		warn("[PlotClaimService] RebirthService require failed: " .. tostring(result))
	end
	return rebirthService
end

local function count(name, n)
	Telemetry.count(name, n or 1)
end

local function isFree(entry)
	return entry.Owner == nil
end

-- Normalize an incoming plot table into the single shared shape (done once).
local function normalize(p, i)
	p.index = p.index or i
	p.theme = p.theme or p.Theme or PlotThemes.getTheme(i)
	if typeof(p.origin) ~= "CFrame" then
		p.origin = (typeof(p.spawnCFrame) == "CFrame") and p.spawnCFrame or PlotThemes.getSlotCFrame(i)
	end
	if typeof(p.spawnCFrame) ~= "CFrame" then
		p.spawnCFrame = p.origin
	end
	p.gate = p.gate or p.Gate
	if not p.gate then
		local ok, g = pcall(PlazaBuilder.buildClaimGate, p.origin, p.theme)
		if ok then
			p.gate = g
		end
	end
	p.plot = p.plot or p.data or p.plotData or p
	p.Owner = nil
	return p
end

-- Gate hide / restore -------------------------------------------------------
local function gateInstances(gate)
	local list = {}
	if not gate or not gate.Parent then
		return list
	end
	table.insert(list, gate)
	for _, d in gate:GetDescendants() do
		table.insert(list, d)
	end
	return list
end

local function hideGate(entry)
	local saved = {}
	for _, inst in gateInstances(entry.gate) do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(saved, { inst, "Transparency", inst.Transparency })
			table.insert(saved, { inst, "CanTouch", inst.CanTouch })
			inst.Transparency = 1
			inst.CanTouch = false
		elseif inst:IsA("BillboardGui") or inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or inst:IsA("Light") then
			table.insert(saved, { inst, "Enabled", inst.Enabled })
			inst.Enabled = false
		end
	end
	gateState[entry] = saved
end

local function showGate(entry)
	local saved = gateState[entry]
	gateState[entry] = nil
	if not saved then
		return
	end
	for _, rec in saved do
		local inst = rec[1]
		if inst and inst.Parent then
			inst[rec[2]] = rec[3]
		end
	end
end

-- Claim / release -----------------------------------------------------------
local function teleportToPlot(player, entry)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	char:PivotTo(entry.spawnCFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
end

local function claim(player, entry, auto)
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players or not entry then
		return false
	end
	-- Owner check and assignment happen with no yield in between, so
	-- simultaneous Touched events cannot double-claim a plot.
	if busy[player] or claimedBy[player] or not isFree(entry) then
		return false
	end
	busy[player] = true
	entry.Owner = player
	claimedBy[player] = entry

		entry.gate:SetAttribute("Owner", player.Name)
	end
	player:SetAttribute("PlotIndex", entry.index)

		tycoons[entry] = t or true

	end
	teleportToPlot(player, entry)

	local rebirth = getRebirthService()
	if rebirth and rebirth.onPlotClaimed then

		if not rok then
			warn("[PlotClaimService] RebirthService.onPlotClaimed failed: " .. tostring(rerr))
		end
	end

	-- Counters: exactly once per successful claim.
	count("plots_claimed")
	count("plot_assigned")

	end

		if not rok then
			warn("[PlotClaimService] RebirthService.onPlotReleased failed: " .. tostring(rerr))
		end

-- ForgeTelemetry: tiny counter API for generated games. ForgeProbe reports these counters.
--
--   local ForgeTelemetry = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ForgeTelemetry)
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("coins_collected")      -- +1
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("damage_dealt", 25)     -- +25
--   ForgeTelemetry.get()                          -- { coins_collected = 1, damage_dealt = 25 }
--
-- Counters live as number attributes on ServerStorage.ForgeCounters (a Folder), so every VM in the
-- server (game scripts, ForgeProbe, execute_luau) sees the same values. Server only: on the client
-- count() is a no-op and get() returns {}.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local FOLDER_NAME = "ForgeCounters"

local ForgeTelemetry = {}

local function folder(): Instance?
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return nil
	end
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local f = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		f.Parent = ServerStorage
	end
	return f
end

-- Attribute names: letters, digits and underscores, max 100 chars, may not start with "RBX".
local function key(name: string): string
	local k = string.gsub(tostring(name), "[^%w_]", "_")
	if k == "" then
		k = "_"
	end
	if string.sub(k, 1, 3) == "RBX" then
		k = "_" .. k
	end
	return string.sub(k, 1, 100)
end

function ForgeTelemetry.count(name: string, n: number?)
	local f = folder()
	if not f then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local k = key(name)
		local cur = f:GetAttribute(k)
		local add = tonumber(n) or 1
		f:SetAttribute(k, (if type(cur) == "number" then cur else 0) + add)
	end)
	if not ok then
		-- telemetry must never break the game
		return
	end
end

function ForgeTelemetry.get(): { [string]: number }
	local out: { [string]: number } = {}
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return out
	end
	local f = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		return out
	end
	for k, v in f:GetAttributes() do
		if type(v) == "number" then
			out[k] = v
		end
	end
	return out
end

return ForgeTelemetry
